To bless a wooden stake you need an ancient prayer spoken by ten priests, each in a different city. You buy a {item:Wooden Stake} from {npc:Gamon} in Thais and carry the stake from temple to temple across the mainland, receiving one line of the prayer in each. At the end you receive the {item:Blessed Wooden Stake} and, if you go to {npc:Chondur}, the achievement **Blessed!** and the possibility of blessing more stakes.
According to a myth, it is possible to extract the essence of a profane creature using a blessed artefact.
Premium (the first 5 lines of the prayer can be done on a Free account, but then the quest sends you to Edron).
{wiki:Meriana Quest} — only needed for the Blessed! achievement and for Chondur to bless extra stakes; not needed for the Blessed Wooden Stake.
5000 gp for the {item:Wooden Stake} (another 5000 gp if you want to buy a second one).
**Blessed!** achievement (when talking to Chondur at the end; needs the Meriana Quest)
{npc:Chondur} will bless one {item:Wooden Stake} of yours per week
At the end of the quest, when you talk to Chondur in Meriana ({key:wooden stake}).
Blesses one of your own {item:Wooden Stake} per week (real time). You need the {wiki:Meriana Quest}.
**Buy two stakes right away** from Gamon: the first time you can bless two on the same day (one with Tyrias, one with Chondur). You keep one and sell the other.
Each step is recorded in the {wiki:Quest Log} ("Friends and Traders"), so you can stop and continue later.
With all the priests the phrase is always the same: {key:hi}, {key:wooden stake}, {key:yes}.
Go to the temple of **Thais** and talk to {npc:Quentin}: {key:hi}, {key:wooden stake}, {key:yes}. He sends you to get a stake from Gamon.
Go to the shop in the northeast corner of {wiki:Mill Avenue} and talk to {npc:Gamon}: {key:hi}, {key:wooden stake}, {key:yes}. You pay **5000 gp** and receive the {item:Wooden Stake}.
Buy the second one now, if you want (another 5000 gp).
Go back to {npc:Quentin} with the stake: {key:hi}, {key:wooden stake}, {key:yes}.
Suggested route, with the transport and cost of each trip.
Follow this order. At each priest say {key:hi}, {key:wooden stake} and {key:yes}.
Boat (→Edron, 40 gp), Magic Carpet (80 gp) or Ore Wagon (250 gp)
Take the boat to **Carlin**. {npc:Tibra} is west of the depot. Say {key:hi}, {key:wooden stake}, {key:yes}.
Take the boat to **Ab'Dendriel**. {npc:Maealil} is in the temple. Say {key:hi}, {key:wooden stake}, {key:yes}.
Take the boat to **Venore**. {npc:Yberius} is in the temple, east of the central depot. Say {key:hi}, {key:wooden stake}, {key:yes}.

Go to **Kazordoon**, the dwarf city inside the mountain The Big Old One ({coord:32614,31923,7}). You can get there on foot through the mountain entrance (bring a {item:Rope} and {item:Shovel}: there are rope spots and hidden holes) or by the {wiki:Steamship} from Cormaya (near Edron, with {npc:Gurbasch}: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}). {npc:Isimov} is in the temple, four floors below ground. Say {key:hi}, {key:wooden stake}, {key:yes}.
Take the Magic Carpet to **Edron**. {npc:Amanda} is in the temple. Say {key:hi}, {key:wooden stake}, {key:yes}.
Take the Magic Carpet to **Darashia**. {npc:Kasmir} is in the temple, 6 floors above the depot. Say {key:hi}, {key:wooden stake}, {key:yes}.
Take the boat to **Ankrahmun**. {npc:Rahkem} is in the citizenship temple. Say {key:hi}, {key:wooden stake}, {key:yes}.
Take the boat to **Port Hope**. {npc:Brewster} is in the temple, west of the depot. Say {key:hi}, {key:wooden stake}, {key:yes}.
Take the boat to **Liberty Bay**. {npc:Tyrias} is in the temple, northwest of the depot. Say {key:hi}, {key:wooden stake}, {key:yes}. The stake turns into the {item:Blessed Wooden Stake}.

In Liberty Bay, go to the small peninsula **southeast** of the depot and talk to {npc:Captain Waverider}: {key:hi}, {key:peg leg}, {key:yes} (50 gp). He takes you to **Sabrehaven**, on the island of **Meriana**. Go to the northeast part of the island, north of Sabrehaven. Talk to {npc:Chondur}: {key:hi}, {key:wooden stake}. You earn the **Blessed!** achievement.

You need to have done the {wiki:Meriana Quest} for this. {npc:Captain Waverider} only takes you to Meriana after the Meriana access mission of the {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest|Shattered Isles Quest}.
If you brought a second {item:Wooden Stake}, say {key:wooden stake} and {key:yes} again. Chondur blesses it right away (this starts the one-week waiting time).
To return to **Liberty Bay**, go **south** of Sabrehaven and talk to {npc:Sebastian}: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes} (50 gp).
After the quest, you can take a {item:Wooden Stake} straight to {npc:Chondur} and he blesses it, as many times as you like, but only **once a week** (real time).
If a week has not passed yet, Chondur replies: *"sorry I'm still exhausted from the last ritual. come back later and try again."*
